keywords: flash band, asphalt flash band, self adhesive flashing tape, flash band for gutters, aluminium flash band, flash band vs butyl tape

heading.en: Flash Band as a Repair Material
heading.zh: 泛水胶带作为修补材料

body.en: Asphalt flash band is a self adhesive flashing tape used to stop water entering around joints, cracks and changes of plane. A typical product combines an aluminium foil facing, a rubberized asphalt or bituminous adhesive layer, and a silicone-coated release liner. It is useful for repairing roof edges, gutter joints, chimney abutments, skylight frames, pipe penetrations and small defects in metal or masonry surfaces. It is a repair material, not a substitute for a failed roof deck, rotten timber, loose membrane or structurally moving joint. Before buying, confirm the substrate, required width, adhesive thickness, facing type and expected exposure. Typical adhesive thicknesses are about 1.0 to 1.5 mm, but the actual value must come from the product datasheet. For procurement, ask for roll length, core size, carton quantity, pallet arrangement and net and gross weight, because these affect container loading and handling costs. If the project is in Zimbabwe, Zambia, South Africa or Mozambique, also check whether the tape will travel through Beira or Durban and whether hot storage, dust and long outdoor staging are likely. A practical specification should state colour, foil thickness, minimum application temperature, overlap requirement and packaging marks. ASTM D1970 may be used as a reference target for self-adhering bituminous sheet, but conformity must be agreed against the supplier’s technical datasheet and inspection plan.
body.zh: 沥青泛水胶带是一种自粘式防水修补材料，用于阻止水从接缝、裂缝和不同平面交界处进入。典型产品由铝箔表层、橡胶改性沥青或沥青胶粘层以及硅油离型膜组成，适合修补屋面边缘、天沟接头、烟囱与屋面交界、天窗框、管道穿透部位，以及金属或砌体表面的较小缺陷。它属于修补材料，不能替代已经失效的屋面基层、腐朽木材、松动防水层或持续位移的结构缝。采购前应确认基层类型、所需宽度、胶层厚度、表面材料和预计暴露条件。胶层厚度通常约为1.0至1.5毫米，但应以产品技术资料为准。采购时还应询问卷材长度、纸管尺寸、每箱数量、托盘方式及净重和毛重，因为这些因素会影响装柜和搬运成本。如果项目位于津巴布韦、赞比亚、南非或莫桑比克，还应确认货物是否经贝拉港或德班港运输，以及是否可能经历高温仓储、粉尘和较长时间的户外暂存。实用规格应写明颜色、铝箔厚度、最低施工温度、搭接要求和包装标识。ASTM D1970可作为自粘沥青片材的参考目标，但最终符合性应依据供应商技术资料和双方确认的检验计划。

body.en: The buying decision depends on how the tape forms a continuous waterproof layer. The aluminium flash band surface reflects sunlight, protects the adhesive from direct weathering and provides a finish that can be shaped over details. The underside is normally a pressure-sensitive rubberized asphalt compound. It does not cure like cement or two-part resin; it wets the prepared surface when pressure is applied and fills small irregularities. The release liner protects the adhesive during winding and must be removed immediately before installation. A useful technical comparison is flash band versus butyl tape. Asphalt flash band generally offers a heavier bituminous mass and is widely selected for roofing and gutter repairs, while butyl tape is often chosen where a cleaner, more elastic seal is required. Neither material should be judged by name alone. Ask whether the adhesive is compatible with PVC, polycarbonate, coated steel, aluminium, concrete, brick and treated timber. Some plastics, oily coatings and bitumen-softening products can cause staining or poor adhesion. A typical specification should also identify foil finish, elongation or flexibility information, peel or adhesion test method, and storage temperature. If a project references EN 13969, ASTM D1970 or another standard, treat that reference as a target or evaluation method unless the supplier provides documented conformity for the exact product. Always test one roll on the actual substrate before approving a large purchase.
body.zh: 采购时应重点判断胶带如何形成连续的防水层。铝箔泛水胶带的表面能够反射阳光，减少胶层直接受到天气影响，并提供可沿细部塑形的外层。底部通常是压敏型橡胶改性沥青胶料。它不像水泥或双组分树脂那样固化，而是在施加压力后润湿基层，并填补基层上的细小不平整。离型膜在卷绕和运输过程中保护胶层，施工前应立即撕除。比较沥青泛水胶带与丁基胶带时，沥青胶带通常含有较厚的沥青胶料，常用于屋面和天沟修补；丁基胶带则常用于需要更清洁、更有弹性的密封场合。不能只凭名称判断产品。应询问胶带是否适用于PVC、聚碳酸酯、涂层钢板、铝材、混凝土、砖和防腐木材。部分塑料、含油涂层及可能软化沥青的材料会导致渗色或粘结不良。规格中还应写明铝箔表面、延伸率或柔韧性资料、剥离或粘结测试方法以及储存温度。如果项目引用EN 13969、ASTM D1970或其他标准，应将其视为目标标准或评估方法，除非供应商能针对具体产品提供有文件支持的符合性。大批量批准前，应先在实际基层上试贴一卷。

heading.en: Widths for Gutters, Laps and Penetrations
heading.zh: 天沟、搭接与穿透部位的宽度选择

body.en: Choose width from the detail, not only from the roll price. Common commercial widths include 50, 75, 100, 150, 225 and 300 mm, with other widths available by production arrangement. For a narrow gutter joint or a small pipe collar, 50 or 75 mm may be sufficient when the tape is centred and the bonded margins remain sound. For roof sheet laps, 100 or 150 mm is more practical because it leaves bonding area on both sides of the joint. For a gutter corner, parapet return or irregular penetration, 225 or 300 mm can reduce the number of pieces and make it easier to form the tape without creating a seam at the corner. Measure the repair zone and add the required overlap before ordering. A common field practice is to allow at least 50 mm of sound adhesion beyond each side of a joint; the correct figure depends on the design and product instructions. Where two strips meet end to end, use the supplier’s specified end lap, often in the 75 to 100 mm range as a typical working allowance, and press the seam firmly. Avoid stretching the tape to gain coverage, because tension can pull the edges back after installation. For gutters, check whether the width fits below the waterline and around the profile without blocking outlets. For penetrations, plan a base strip plus shaped pieces or a collar detail. Order widths that minimize waste while keeping seams away from standing water.
body.zh: 胶带宽度应根据节点尺寸选择，而不能只看单卷价格。常见商业宽度包括50、75、100、150、225和300毫米，也可根据生产安排提供其他宽度。对于窄天沟接缝或小型管道收口，如果胶带居中铺贴且两侧基层牢固，50或75毫米可能已经足够。对于屋面板搭接，100或150毫米更实用，因为接缝两侧都能保留足够的粘结面积。对于天沟转角、女儿墙翻边或形状不规则的穿透部位，225或300毫米可减少拼接数量，也更容易塑形，避免在转角处形成新的接缝。测量修补区域时，应在订货尺寸中加入搭接余量。现场常见做法是在接缝两侧各保留至少50毫米的完整粘结宽度，但最终数值应依据设计和产品说明确定。两条胶带端对端连接时，应采用供应商规定的端部搭接长度；作为典型施工余量，通常可按75至100毫米考虑，并充分压实接缝。不要为了增加覆盖面积而拉伸胶带，因为张力可能使边缘在施工后回缩。用于天沟时，应确认宽度能位于水线以下并绕过型材，同时不遮挡落水口。用于穿透部位时，应提前规划底部条带、成型片或套环节点。应选择能减少废料且能让接缝避开积水位置的宽度。

body.en: Most failures come from weak preparation rather than from the tape itself. First remove loose coating, rust scale, dust, algae, grease and old sealant from the repair zone. The surface should be structurally sound, dry and sufficiently smooth for continuous contact. Brush or vacuum dust away; use a compatible cleaner only when it will not leave an oily film. On porous concrete, brick or timber, ask whether a primer is recommended and allow it to dry fully. Do not install over standing water, frost, condensation or a surface that is too hot to handle safely. A typical working range for self adhesive flashing tape is about 5 to 40°C, but the product label controls. Cut the roll to length before removing the liner, leaving enough material to form corners and maintain the specified overlap. Position one edge first, then lower the tape progressively to avoid trapping air. Peel the liner gradually rather than exposing the whole adhesive at once. Press from the centre toward the edges with a hand roller or firm applicator, paying special attention to seams, corners and textured surfaces. For a pipe penetration, slit or shape the tape carefully and keep the main drainage path open. Seal exposed edges when the specification requires it. If the substrate is dusty, wet, moving or chemically incompatible, stop and correct the condition. Record lot identification, application temperature and substrate type for each trial area.
body.zh: 大多数失效来自基层处理不足，而不是胶带本身。首先应清除修补区域内的松动涂层、锈皮、灰尘、藻类、油脂和旧密封胶。基层应结构牢固、干燥，并足够平整，以保证胶带连续接触。应使用刷子或吸尘器清除灰尘；只有在清洁剂不会留下油膜时，才可使用相容清洁剂。对于多孔混凝土、砖或木材，应询问是否需要底涂，并让底涂完全干燥。不得将胶带铺设在积水、霜冻、冷凝水或温度过高而无法安全操作的表面上。自粘泛水胶带的典型施工温度约为5至40摄氏度，但应以产品标签为准。去除离型膜前，先按长度裁切胶带，并预留转角成型和规定搭接所需的材料。先定位一条边，再逐步放下胶带，以避免困住空气。应逐步撕开离型膜，不要一次暴露全部胶面。使用手压滚轮或坚硬的压实工具，从中心向边缘施压，重点压实接缝、转角和纹理基层。处理管道穿透部位时，应仔细切割或塑形，并保持主要排水通道畅通。若规格要求，应对外露边缘进行封边。如果基层有灰尘、潮湿、持续位移或存在化学不相容性，应停止施工并先纠正条件。每个试贴区域都应记录批次标识、施工温度和基层类型。

heading.zh: 紫外线暴露与使用寿命

body.en: Aluminium-faced asphalt flash band can tolerate outdoor exposure better than an unprotected bituminous adhesive, but no universal service-life number should be promised without the exact formulation, test method and installation details. The foil reflects part of the solar load and shields the adhesive, while the adhesive still remains sensitive to edge lifting, heat cycling, ponding water and movement at the joint. In southern African projects, strong sun, high daytime temperatures, dust and seasonal rain can expose weak edges quickly, especially on dark metal roofs. Treat any advertised service-life figure as product-specific and ask whether it applies to fully bonded tape, vertical exposure, intermittent exposure or an edge-sealed system. For durable work, keep the tape as flat as possible, roll every edge, avoid wrinkles and keep seams out of permanent water. Where the design allows, protect the repair with a compatible cover, coating or flashing detail; confirm chemical compatibility before applying paint or sealant over the foil. Inspect exposed repairs after the first heavy rain and at least annually, checking foil tears, lifted edges, bubbles, corrosion beneath the repair and cracking at moving interfaces. Replace or reinforce the tape if the substrate has moved or if water is travelling behind the bond line. For export procurement, specify storage away from direct sunlight and excessive heat, and use cartons that protect roll edges during handling through Beira or Durban. The correct goal is controlled exposure, not an unsupported lifetime guarantee.
body.zh: 带铝箔表面的沥青泛水胶带通常比未受保护的沥青胶层更能承受户外暴露，但如果没有具体配方、测试方法和施工细节，不应承诺一个适用于所有产品的固定使用寿命。铝箔可以反射部分太阳辐射并保护胶层，但胶层仍容易受到边缘翘起、热循环、积水以及接缝位移的影响。在南部非洲项目中，强烈日照、白天高温、粉尘和季节性降雨可能很快暴露边缘处理不足的问题，尤其是在深色金属屋面上。任何宣传中的使用寿命都应视为针对特定产品的数据，并应询问它适用于完全粘结、垂直暴露、间歇暴露，还是已经封边的系统。为了提高耐久性，应尽量使胶带保持平整，压实所有边缘，避免褶皱，并让接缝避开长期积水位置。如果设计允许，可使用相容的覆盖层、涂层或泛水构造保护修补处；在铝箔上涂漆或打密封胶前，应确认化学相容性。首次大雨后以及至少每年一次检查外露修补位置，观察铝箔撕裂、边缘翘起、鼓泡、修补层下方腐蚀以及活动界面处开裂。如果基层发生位移，或水已经沿粘结线后方流动，应更换或加强胶带。出口采购时，应规定避开阳光直射和过热环境储存，并使用能够保护卷材边缘的纸箱，以适应经贝拉港或德班港运输过程中的搬运。正确目标是控制暴露条件，而不是作出没有依据的寿命保证。

body.en: Use flash band when the defect is localized, the surrounding substrate is sound and the repair can be bonded continuously. Typical examples include a split at a metal lap, a leaking gutter corner, a small hole around a pipe or a failed sealant line that is not caused by structural movement. Replacement is usually the better decision when the roof sheet is broadly corroded, the membrane is brittle across a large area, timber is rotten, insulation is saturated, fasteners are loose over a whole panel, or water has entered behind the assembly. A strip of tape can stop a symptom while leaving the source untouched. During inspection, map the leak, not only the visible stain. Check the upper side, underside, drainage direction, fasteners, laps and nearby penetrations. A repair should also leave enough sound margin for adhesion; if the defect reaches an edge or a contaminated coating, cut back or replace the affected material first. For a temporary emergency repair, mark the installation date and plan a permanent inspection. For a planned project, compare tape area, labour, access equipment, removal, disposal and future inspection costs against replacement. Do not use asphalt flash band to bridge a moving expansion joint unless the system is designed for that movement. For export buyers, send photographs and measurements with the inquiry so the supplier can suggest widths and roll lengths without assuming the entire roof condition. The final choice should be made by the responsible contractor or engineer.
body.zh: 当缺陷局部存在、周围基层牢固，并且胶带能够连续粘结时，适合使用泛水胶带。典型情况包括金属板搭接处开裂、天沟转角漏水、管道周围的小孔，以及并非由结构位移造成的失效密封胶线。如果屋面板大面积腐蚀、防水层大范围变脆、木材已经腐朽、保温层已经吸水、整块板上的紧固件普遍松动，或水已经进入构造内部，通常更适合更换。胶带可能暂时阻止表面症状，却无法消除根本原因。检查时应追踪漏水路径，而不仅仅是可见水渍。应检查上表面、下表面、排水方向、紧固件、搭接处和附近穿透部位。修补还必须保留足够宽的完整基层，以保证粘结；如果缺陷已经到达边缘或被污染的涂层，应先切除或更换受影响材料。对于临时应急修补，应标记施工日期，并安排后续永久性检查。对于计划性项目，应把胶带面积、人工、登高设备、拆除、废弃物处理和后续检查成本与更换成本进行比较。除非系统专门设计用于承受位移，否则不要用沥青泛水胶带跨越活动伸缩缝。出口采购商可在询价时提供照片和尺寸，使供应商能在不假设整个屋面状况的前提下建议宽度和卷长。最终选择应由负责的承包商或工程师决定。

body.en: A clear purchase order prevents the wrong tape from arriving at site. State the product name, foil colour, roll width, roll length, adhesive thickness if specified, release-liner type, core diameter, carton quantity and pallet requirement. Include the application, such as gutters, roof laps, penetrations or general repair, and identify the expected substrates. If the buyer needs a particular target standard, write it as a technical requirement and request the relevant datasheet, test report or inspection record for the exact model; do not accept a generic certificate for a different product. Ask for production batch marking, outer-carton labels, barcode requirements and language requirements before packing. Roll edges should be protected against crushing, and cartons should resist normal container handling. Confirm whether rolls are packed vertically or horizontally, how many cartons fit per pallet, whether pallets are fumigated or heat-treated where required, and the net and gross weights. For shipments to Zimbabwe, Zambia, South Africa or Mozambique, agree the delivery term, port or inland destination, moisture protection and document set before dispatch. Beira and Durban routing can involve multiple handling stages, so corner protection and stretch wrapping deserve attention. Keep rolls away from direct sun and high heat during storage; do not place heavy goods on top of cartons. Request a packing list that matches the actual roll count, dimensions and weights. TradeGo can use these details to prepare a factory-direct quotation for evaluation, but final price, lead time and packing must be confirmed against the actual specification and order.
body.zh: 清晰的采购订单可以避免现场收到错误型号的胶带。订单应写明产品名称、铝箔颜色、卷宽、卷长、胶层厚度要求、离型膜类型、纸管直径、每箱数量和托盘要求。还应写明应用场景，例如天沟、屋面搭接、穿透部位或一般修补，并标识预计使用的基层。如果买方要求某项目标标准，应将其写成技术要求，并要求供应商提供针对具体型号的技术资料、测试报告或检验记录；不要接受其他产品的通用证书。包装前应确认生产批次标识、外箱标签、条形码和语言要求。卷材边缘应有防压保护，纸箱应能够承受正常集装箱搬运。应确认卷材采用立放还是平放、每托盘装多少箱、在需要时托盘是否经过熏蒸或热处理，以及净重和毛重。发往津巴布韦、赞比亚、南非或莫桑比克的货物，应在发运前确认贸易术语、港口或内陆目的地、防潮措施和单据清单。经贝拉港或德班港运输时可能经历多次搬运，因此护角和缠绕膜值得重视。储存时应避免阳光直射和高温，不要在纸箱上堆放重物。应要求装箱单与实际卷数、尺寸和重量一致。TradeGo可根据这些信息准备工厂直供报价供评估，但最终价格、交期和包装方式必须以实际规格和订单确认为准。

metaDescription.hi: गटर, छत के जोड़ों और पाइप पासिंग के लिए सेल्फ-अडेसिव बिटुमिनस फ्लैश बैंड की चौड़ाई, चिपकाने के तरीके, यूवी सीमा और पैकिंग की तुलना करें।
